title: Guide to Integrating Forensic Techniques into Incident Response (NIST SP 800-86)
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
article_use: Supports identifying relevant sources, volatility, deliberate acquisition and documentation before troubleshooting changes state
material_limitations: Published in 2006; focused on computer-security incident response and some IT troubleshooting; not self-storage guidance, a reset mandate, legal advice or permission to collect data

title: Guidelines for Evidence Collection and Archiving (RFC 3227)
article_use: Supports sequencing authorized collection from more volatile to less volatile evidence and documenting collection steps
material_limitations: Published in 2002 for security evidence; techniques and evidentiary framing do not automatically apply to routine facility operations and do not override privacy, policy, vendor or legal limits

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile (NIST AI 600-1)
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
article_use: Supports provenance, documented limitations, human oversight roles, inventories, monitoring and retention practices
material_limitations: Voluntary cross-sector guidance; it does not prescribe a self-storage troubleshooting workflow, evidence-preservation gate or product implementation

title: Incident Response Recommendations and Considerations for Cybersecurity Risk Management: A CSF 2.0 Community Profile (NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3)
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
provenance: Current primary federal cybersecurity incident-response publication
article_use: Supports preparing roles and procedures in advance and improving response through review
material_limitations: Cybersecurity risk-management guidance; not a facility emergency plan, life-safety standard, vendor instruction or proof of a particular system behavior
